marks.gloss_en: Rav Huna: Rosh Chodesh Av that falls on Shabbat -- the haftara is 'your new moons and your festivals My soul hates; they are a burden upon Me'
on the Ninth of Av itself, what is the haftara? Rav: 'how has [the faithful city] become a harlot'
דתנן: ובעצרת על פירות האילן -- Atzeret is a day of judgment, so a new year (kind svara: no SupportKind names דתנן; Megillah convention)
בשלמא שבמשנה תורה, איכא כדי שתכלה שנה וקללותיה; אלא שבתורת כהנים, אטו עצרת ראש השנה היא?
אין, עצרת נמי ראש השנה היא, דתנן: ובעצרת על פירות האילן (= p_atzeret_rosh_hashana)
yes -- Atzeret too is a new year
וסימן לדבר -- רחבעם בן שלמה (kind svara stands in for סימן לדבר; no construct grades it)
if elders tell you 'demolish' and children 'build', demolish and do not build, for the demolishing of elders is building and the building of youths is demolishing
and one does not break off in [the reading of] the curses
Reish Lakish: [one does not break off in the curses] because one does not say a blessing over calamity
they taught [ein mafsikin] only of the curses in Torat Kohanim (Leviticus)
Levi bar Buti was reading and stammering before Rav Huna in the ארורי; Rav Huna said to him: as you wish [you may stop]
Ezra enacted for Israel that they read the curses of Torat Kohanim before Atzeret
where they stop on Shabbat morning, there they read at mincha (both tannaim)
R' Zeira's wording: the halakha is -- where they stop on Shabbat morning, there they read at mincha, on Monday, on Thursday and on the coming Shabbat
from where are these matters? R' Ami: as it says, 'if not My covenant day and night, I would not have set the statutes of heaven and earth'
R' Ami: and it is written, 'and he said, Lord God, by what shall I know that I shall inherit it?'
Avraham ASKED before Him: Master of the world, by what shall I know?
